meta.name: HTTPS Proxy
meta.shortDescription: HTTPS reverse proxy for other pups (TLS self-signed by default + web admin)
meta.longDescription: **TLS is on by default** (self-signed cert, SAN **dogebox** — same hostname works on **any port**). **Dogebox’s panel** reverse-proxies with **HTTP** to **`PUBLIC_PORT`**, so this pup serves **plain HTTP on `PUBLIC_PORT`** and **HTTPS on the companion port** (default **`PUBLIC_PORT+1`**, override **`HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT`**). Use **`http://dogebox:<mapped PUBLIC_PORT>/__proxy/`** from the panel, or **`https://dogebox:<mapped TLS port>/__proxy/`** for HTTPS in the browser. Default admin token **`DOGECOIN`** (override **`HTTPS_PROXY_ADMIN_TOKEN`**). Turn off **Enable HTTPS** for HTTP-only on a single port. **Port listeners:** HTTP on each **`listen_port`** (Dogebox); HTTPS on **`listen_port + HTTPS_PROXY_LISTENER_TLS_OFFSET`** (default 10000). Not Let’s Encrypt.

sections.name: HTTP/TLS
sections.description: With HTTPS on: **HTTP** listens on `PUBLIC_PORT` (Dogebox panel); **TLS** on `HTTPS_PROXY_TLS_PORT` or `PUBLIC_PORT+1`. With port-listener rows, HTTP on each `listen_port` and TLS on `listen_port + offset` (see long description).

sections.name: Storage & admin
sections.description: Config and TLS material persist under HTTPS_PROXY_STORAGE. Set a fixed admin token to skip the generated admin.token file.
